# Veil — Finalized Icon SVGs

Canonical icon set for the Veil app, exported from Figma. All are 24x24, stroke-based,
stroke-width 2, round caps and joins. Stroke color is set to currentColor here so they
inherit the CSS color of their container (swap freely per theme / per state).

Usage: paste the inline SVG, or reference as a file. Color via `color:` on the parent
or `stroke` on the path.

---
